specification_name: Specification A: Independent QA47 Holdout Evaluation
purpose: Constructs customer segments solely from shopping behavior, basket economics, delivery valuation, satisfaction, and routine integration, EXCLUDING QA 47. Allows rigorous, non-circular external validation of whether resulting clusters differ in stated discount resilience.
qa47_status: EXCLUDED from clustering inputs; reserved strictly as external validation holdout.
qa46_status: EXCLUDED from clustering inputs; reserved as stated future-use intention holdout.

target_population.name: Current-User Quick-Commerce Cohort
excluded_groups: Previous Users (Ever Ordered == 1 & Order Frequency == 1, n=80)

features.name: order_frequency
features.description: Current order frequency from Less than once a month (2) to Daily (7).

features.name: usage_duration
features.special_codes: None (code 1 Never Used is absent in active users)
features.description: Quick commerce customer tenure from <3 months (2) to >2 years (6).

features.name: order_spend
features.special_codes: None (code 8 N/A absent in active users)
features.description: Typical single-order spend bracket from Below ₹200 (1) to ₹1,500+ (7).

features.name: monthly_spend_ordinal
features.special_codes: Source codes 2–7 map monotonically to ranks 1.0–6.0. Code 8 ('Not sure', n=24) is structurally undefined on the ordinal spend scale and encoded as NaN. In pairwise Gower distance, if either respondent has Code 8, omit the QA26 ordinal component from the distance denominator (delta_ijk=0). Uncertainty is captured separately by asymmetric binary feature monthly_spend_not_sure.
features.description: Typical monthly quick-commerce spend brackets 2–7 mapped monotonically to ranks 1.0–6.0. Special response Code 8 ('Not sure') has no ordinal rank (NaN) and is omitted from pairwise comparison.

features.name: monthly_spend_not_sure
features.special_codes: 1 if Monthly Spend == 8 ('Not sure', n=24), 0 otherwise. Evaluated as an asymmetric binary variable in Gower distance: (0, 0) pairs are omitted from the distance denominator (delta_ijk=0); (1, 1) pairs match (delta_ijk=1, s_ijk=1); (1, 0) or (0, 1) pairs differ (delta_ijk=1, s_ijk=0).
features.description: Asymmetric binary indicator for spending uncertainty. Joint absence (0, 0) is omitted from the distance denominator, ensuring ordinary spenders are compared solely on spend magnitude without artificial similarity inflation.

features.name: items_per_order_ordinal
features.special_codes: Codes 1–5 map to ordinal ranks 1.0–5.0. Code 6 ('Varies considerably', n=100) is structurally undefined on the ordinal basket-size scale and encoded as NaN. In pairwise Gower distance, if either respondent has Code 6, omit the QA19 ordinal component from the distance denominator (delta_ijk=0). Volatility is captured separately by asymmetric binary feature items_varies_considerably.
features.description: Typical items per order from 1 item (rank 1.0) to >10 items (rank 5.0). Special response Code 6 ('Varies considerably') has no ordinal rank (NaN) and is omitted from pairwise comparison.

features.name: items_varies_considerably
features.special_codes: 1 if Items per Order == 6 ('Varies considerably', n=100), 0 otherwise. Evaluated as an asymmetric binary variable in Gower distance: (0, 0) pairs are omitted from the distance denominator (delta_ijk=0); (1, 1) pairs match (delta_ijk=1, s_ijk=1); (1, 0) or (0, 1) pairs differ (delta_ijk=1, s_ijk=0).
features.description: Asymmetric binary indicator capturing basket size volatility. Joint absence (0, 0) is omitted from the distance denominator, ensuring ordinary basket-size respondents are compared solely on basket rank without artificial similarity inflation.

features.name: discount_overspend
features.special_codes: None (code 6 N/A absent in active users)
features.description: How often discounts/coupons cause overspending (1=Never to 5=Very often). Measures deal-driven basket inflation.

features.name: threshold_extra_items
features.special_codes: None (code 6 N/A absent in active users)
features.description: How often extra items are added to reach free delivery thresholds (1=Never to 5=Very often). Measures fee avoidance gaming.

features.name: compare_platform_prices
features.special_codes: None (code 6 N/A absent in active users)
features.description: Frequency of comparing prices across quick-commerce apps (1=Never to 5=Always). Measures cross-app deal shopping.

features.name: compare_physical_prices
features.special_codes: None (code 6 N/A absent in active users)
features.description: Frequency of comparing quick-commerce prices with physical stores (1=Never to 5=Always). Measures offline-online arbitrage.

features.name: fast_delivery_importance
features.special_codes: None (code 6 N/A absent in active users)
features.description: Stated importance of 10-20 minute delivery (1=Not at all important to 5=Extremely important).

features.name: service_satisfaction_composite
features.special_codes: Constructed mean across 4 items; Cronbach's alpha = 0.863 demonstrates high reliability.

features.name: shopping_routine_role
features.special_codes: Code 6 ('Do not use') is 0 in active users.
features.description: Explicitly nominal quick commerce role (1=Large grocery replacement, 2=Some replacement, 3=Top-up, 4=Urgent/emergencies, 5=Offers/convenience).

features.name: platforms_used_count
features.source_column: Derived sum of 6 major platforms used
features.description: Count of platforms ever used. Measures historical platform-repertoire breadth; does not establish current multi-homing or loyalty.

features.name: unplanned_purchase
features.special_codes: None (code 6 N/A absent in active users)
features.description: How often quick commerce encourages impulse purchases (1=Never to 5=Very often).

features.name: new_brand_trial
features.special_codes: None (code 6 N/A absent in active users)
features.description: Propensity to try new brands through quick commerce (1=Strongly disagree to 5=Strongly agree).

qa47_external_validation.role_in_spec_b: Construct-defining feature (CIRCULAR; cannot be used for independent validation).

qa46_future_use_intention.role: External validation benchmark across BOTH Specification A and Specification B.
qa46_future_use_intention.methodological_boundary: STATED future-use intention, NOT realized retention or observed purchase history.

qa49_preferred_improvement.role: Post-cluster CRM retention action profiling (10 substantive choices).

recommended_clustering_methodology.method: Gower Distance Matrix + Partitioning Around Medoids (PAM)
recommended_clustering_methodology.alternative: Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering (HAC) with Gower Distance
recommended_clustering_methodology.undefined_special_handling: Gower implementation in Gate 1C must omit undefined ordinal components (delta_ijk=0) while evaluating asymmetric binary indicators (items_varies_considerably, monthly_spend_not_sure) to avoid inflating similarity for ordinary (0, 0) pairs.

pairwise_gower_contract.distance_formula: D_ij = 1 - (sum_k w_k * s_ijk * delta_ijk) / (sum_k w_k * delta_ijk)
pairwise_gower_contract.denominator_rule: Sum only feature weights for components eligible to contribute to that respondent pair. Jointly absent asymmetric binary flags (0, 0) and undefined ordinal components must not enter the denominator. If a pair has no comparable features at all (denominator == 0), fail clearly with ValueError rather than silently returning a misleading distance.

qa19_basket_size_contract.ordinary_ordinary: If both respondents have defined QA19 ordinal ranks (source codes 1-5), compare those ranks using documented ordinal distance (range=4.0). items_varies_considerably is (0, 0), omitted from denominator (delta=0). Effective construct weight = 1.0.
qa19_basket_size_contract.special_special: If both respondents have Code 6 ('Varies considerably'), ordinal rank is NaN for both, omitted from denominator (delta=0). items_varies_considerably is (1, 1), included as match (delta=1, s=1). Effective construct weight = 1.0.
qa19_basket_size_contract.ordinary_special: If either respondent has Code 6 while the other has Code 1-5, ordinal rank is omitted (delta=0). items_varies_considerably is (1, 0) or (0, 1), included as mismatch (delta=1, s=0). Effective construct weight = 1.0.

qa26_monthly_spend_contract.ordinary_ordinary: If both respondents have defined spend responses (source codes 2-7), compare ordinal spend ranks (1-6, range=5.0). monthly_spend_not_sure is (0, 0), omitted from denominator (delta=0). Effective construct weight = 1.0.
qa26_monthly_spend_contract.special_special: If both respondents have Code 8 ('Not sure'), ordinal spend rank is NaN for both, omitted from denominator (delta=0). monthly_spend_not_sure is (1, 1), included as match (delta=1, s=1). Effective construct weight = 1.0.
qa26_monthly_spend_contract.ordinary_special: If either respondent has Code 8 while the other has Code 2-7, ordinal spend rank is omitted (delta=0). monthly_spend_not_sure is (1, 0) or (0, 1), included as mismatch (delta=1, s=0). Effective construct weight = 1.0.

pairwise_gower_contract.construct_weight_invariance: For every respondent pair, the QA19 construct contributes exactly 1.0 to the denominator weight, and the QA26 construct contributes exactly 1.0 to the denominator weight. Special-response flags are prevented from redundantly increasing similarity for ordinary (0, 0) pairs.

recommended_clustering_methodology.rationale: Respects mixed ordinal, nominal, and asymmetric binary data natively; provides interpretable real-customer medoids without fractional coordinate distortion.
